summary.text: Maria Peterson is the Democratic candidate for the Illinois House of Representatives, District 52, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An attorney and small business owner, she previously served as an attorney with the U.S. Department of Labor, according to her Ballotpedia survey.

paragraphs.text: Maria Peterson was born in Oak Park, Illinois, graduated from Proviso West High School, earned a bachelor's degree from Loyola University Chicago in 1985 and a law degree from The John Marshall Law School in 1989.

According to her Ballotpedia survey, she is a first-generation Mexican American who served as an attorney with the U.S. Department of Labor, handling workplace safety cases and benefits for coal miners with Black Lung disease.
The survey states that Peterson, a mother of three, worked within Chicago Public Schools to secure special education resources and has served as State Elections Lead for Moms Demand Action.
She advanced from the Democratic primary on March 17, 2026.
In the survey, she said she had knocked on over 33,000 doors and named affordability, environmental protection and gun violence prevention as her key messages.
